stem.text: In 2011 an international group of scientists agreed to add two new elements to the Periodic Table. Both elements had been made artificially and are called flerovium, Fl, and livermorium, Lv.
From the information about atoms in the table, which statements are correct?

items: One atom of Lv has one more neutron than one atom of Fl.
One $\text{Fl}^{2-}$ ion has the same number of electrons as one atom of Lv.
One $\text{Lv}^{+}$ ion has the same number of electrons as one $\text{Fl}^{-}$ ion.
